description:
ROOT CAUSE (measured 2026-08-31 at a0a92a8cb, builder STOP report; evidence
assets in /Users/j5n/Workspace/kdt80-evidence/ -- red-test patch, A1/A2/B
patches, base+A2 canon dumps): the brand-blind activation key is NOT a join
homomorphism. Two observation rows differing only in a captured closure's
BRAND (#67 vs #69) mint the SAME key (brand-blind, fz-6gb); coalescing
(merge_summary_input_vec, semantic.rs:1909-1939) column-wise unions their
activation_inputs; re-minting from the blend (rebuild_coalesced_call_emission,
jobs/semantic.rs:1130-1216) gives a DIFFERENT, wider key:

    activation_key(r1 JOIN r2) != activation_key(r1) = activation_key(r2)

That single shape is 100% of the loss: 70/0/54 loss events per drive
(take_drop/range_map/predicate), 10/0/10 distinct lost keys, all obs>=2,
Resolved, same function, lost key still demanded via
rebuilt_activations.extend(call.activations) (jobs/semantic.rs:~1200).
456/526 rebuilds on take_drop are already join-stable (from==to); the 70
that are not are exactly the losses.

THE EDGE'S DISHONESTY AND THE ARTIFACT'S SHARING ARE THE SAME FACT: the
re-mint is the mechanism by which two lambda brands share one library-chain
executable. Making the edge honest without fixing the key UN-SHARES them.

## THE FIX: make the activation key join-stable
If the union of key-equivalent callables is key-equivalent to them, then
from==to for every rebuild BY CONSTRUCTION, loss is 0, the re-mint becomes
a provable no-op and is DELETED (rip-out law), and the artifact does not
move at all. Sits on the fz-6gb/fz-bsx brand-blindness line: one erasure
source-of-truth must commute with Types::union (erase-then-union ==
union-then-erase up to key equivalence). Full ritual: dig the union/erasure
code, cold-review the proposal, then build.

## INVARIANT TEST (production-path, red at base)
AnalyzeActivation reads ReturnType at exactly one site
(prepare_function_call, jobs/semantic.rs:1848-1868), so standing
ReturnType reads ARE the walked callees. Test: every ReturnType(k) read
standing in the ledger appears in a CallSiteTargets edge the analysis
claims. RED at base: (10,10)/(0,0)/(10,10) losing analyses/lost keys.
Patch: kdt80-evidence/kdt80.red-test.patch.

## MEASURED REPAIRS -- ALL MOVE THE ARTIFACT, ALL PARKED (do not land
without explicit authorization; artifact-neutrality is the campaign gate)
- A1 delete the re-mint (publish only walked): MISCOMPILES
  (Enum.take([1,2,3,4,5],3) -> [1,2,3,4,5]) -- the blended surface and a
  single row's identity cannot coexist on one target. Inventory 59/204/222.
- A2 edge names walked UNION rebuilt (one line): loss 0/0/0, behavior 3/3
  identical, but inventory 59/221/214 -> 59/231/224, purely additive (+10
  per key-losing fixture: the orphan reduce_while/3 narrow-seed specs), and
  compiler2_same_shape_lambda_literals_share_the_library_chain INVERTS
  (marginal lambda cost +3 -> +5). Canon differs from byte 40 on two
  fixtures. Patch: kdt80-evidence/kdt80.A2.patch.
- B demand-what-is-published (drop the extend): loss only halves (0/5/5),
  artifact still moves (59/204/222). Patch: kdt80-evidence/kdt80.B.patch.

## ACCEPTANCE (for the join-stable fix)
Invariant test GREEN; loss events 0/0/0 by construction; re-mint deleted
same commit; canon byte-identical; pins hold 59/221/214; lambda-sharing
pin holds (+3); lib+cli+matrix green; zero-uncaused unweakened.

PROBE RECIPE: env-gated eprintln in analyze_activation around the coalesce
+ rebuild loop; FZ_KDT80_PROBE=1 fz2 build <fixture> -o /tmp/x.
title: Activation key is not a join homomorphism: brand union re-mints a wider key -- make the key join-stable, then the coalesce re-mint deletes
